blocks.text: LEGAZPI CITY, ALBAY, Philippines — Two alleged members of an emerging criminal group were killed in a shootout with police during a gun buy-bust operation in Barangay Rawis here on Sunday afternoon, Nov. 22. A police officer was also wounded in the encounter, which occurred at around 4 p.m. in Purok 5, according to Albay police director Col. Noel Nuñez. Nuñez said the suspects apparently realized they were dealing with undercover police officers and opened fire on the operatives, triggering a gunfight.
